verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's docs cover each part of the story. Events API integrations deduplicate alerts that share a `dedup_key` (pagerduty-docs-3), and Event Orchestration can deduplicate or suppress alerts (pagerduty-docs-43). Intelligent Alert Grouping uses machine learning to merge related alerts into a single incident (pagerduty-docs-4), and escalation policies notify one target at a time until someone acknowledges (pagerduty-docs-37). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well deduplication and grouping work in practice (the 91% noise-reduction figure is vendor marketing only).
